pages.text: SYN Market Wire weekly wrap for the week ending 2026-08-28. The SSE All-Share Index closed the week ending 2026-08-28 at 2,068.61 points. The 91-day Treasury bill auction that week cleared at 9.71 percent. Weekly turnover on the exchange was SYN Sh 1,321 million. The top gainer of the week was Upepo Agri (SYN).

Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. Industry groups welcomed the clarity but asked for more investor education.
